purpose: Read-only Last-Git-Commit reference manifest for high export-intelligence Create prompts.

trigger_policy.detail_rule: Export-Intelligenz Hoch includes changed-file title and description rows in the prompt intro and stores the full payload in LAST_GIT_COMMIT.json.

guardrails: Manifest is read-only context and never grants Git write access.
Commit metadata is not proof that current working files still match the commit.
When absolute_project_paths is enabled, relative originals are preserved in relative_* fields.
ZIP member names remain project-relative even when manifest paths are absolute.
